blocks.content: Let's write a program to calculate the sum of odd numbers entered by the user.

items: Skip even numbers using the continue statement.
Terminate the program when the user enters 0 using the break statement.

blocks.content: Since we don't know in advance when the user wants to stop, we'll use a while loop to allow repeated inputs.
